constitutional_wiring.Art_XXV: all unresolved states remain typed unknowns
constitutional_wiring.Art_XLVI: the verdict vocabulary contains NO novelty verdict; NO_COLLISION_FOUND states exactly what it measured and nothing more
constitutional_wiring.Art_LXI: infrastructure states (RETRIEVAL_INCOMPLETE, AUTH_FAILED, PATENT_BLIND) are distinct from scientific verdicts
